benchmark: INPE TerraBrasilis PRODES Amazon annual increments
measurement_source: The generated summary artifact is the runner output copied unchanged after an archive-only rerun. This evidence record adds provenance, interpretation, caveats, and verification status.

sampling.method: Five fixed 0.1-degree Para cells selected from the 2024 PRODES truth distribution before detector scoring: showcase anchor plus low-medium, medium, high, and very-high clearing density.
sampling.selection_leakage_guard: Window bounds and Sentinel-2 scene IDs were fixed before any detector metric was observed.

truth.product: Yearly deforestation increments - Shapefile (since 2008), Amazon biome
truth.semantics: Official annual PRODES deforestation increment polygons. image_date is retained as source-acquisition provenance and every selected acquisition is required to fall inside its pinned Sentinel-2 interval.

interpretation.primary_limitation: Precision is low overall: emitted forest-change polygons cover substantially more area than PRODES truth in four of five windows.
interpretation.showcase_failure: Novo Progresso precision is 0.011 because 540.95 ha was emitted against 14.28 ha of valid PRODES truth.
interpretation.dense_window_failure: The very-high clearing window is recall-limited at 0.351 despite better precision of 0.296.
interpretation.claim_scope: Accuracy of the unchanged shipped classical forest preset on five fixed Para PRODES 2024 windows; not a statewide, Amazon-wide, or general forest-monitoring estimate.

caveats: The five windows are truth-stratified and fixed before scoring, but they are not a random or statistically representative sample of Para or the Amazon biome.

PRODES year identifies the annual increment class; image_date is source-acquisition provenance. Every selected image_date is bracketed by its Sentinel-2 pair, but the pair can include changes outside the exact PRODES interpretation date.
PRODES uses analyst interpretation from multiple satellite sensors and is authoritative ground truth, but it is not independent of optical satellite imagery as a modality.
Pixels invalid in either Sentinel-2 SCL plane are excluded from scoring.
The emitted polygons are rasterised and scored after morphology and the 3,000 m2 minimum-area floor.
The 2026 reprocessed archive contains isolated anomalous records outside this benchmark's year/state/source/window filters; fail-closed identity and spatial checks exclude them.
No forest threshold or production detector behavior was changed based on this benchmark.

verification.benchmark_command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps -v <official-archive>:/truth.zip:ro api python -m overwatch.eval.run_prodes --archive /truth.zip
verification.benchmark_result: exit 0; five windows scored; generated summary pooled counts matched the reported micro-average
verification.focused_tests_command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps api pytest -q tests/test_eval_prodes.py tests/test_eval_run_prodes.py
